summary: M4 Internal Notification Center: full backend + frontend verification. 20/20 pytest cases pass (categories, debug publish + unread-count delta, high_priority_count, list filters, mark read, mark-all-read, archive, archive-read bulk, preferences with opt-out skip, hooks new_contact / new_activity / activity_assigned, debug cron). Frontend: bell visible in topbar on /dashboard, initial GET /api/notifications/categories + /api/notifications/unread-count fire on mount, badge with unread count rendered, drawer opens via portal with all 3 tabs (all/unread/archived), per-item archive button present, clicking a new_contact item navigated to /relations/{account_id} (deep link resolved from payload). RBAC 403 verified cross-user for PATCH /read and POST /archive. Cron debug endpoint returns {ok:true, scanned, emitted, skipped}.

issues: Pre-existing React warning 'Cannot update a component (LocalizationOverlay) while rendering a different component' still fires on mount — same residual as iteration_206, non-blocking, unrelated to M4.

action_items: (LOW) Same LocalizationOverlay setState-in-render warning carried over from prior iterations — not part of M4 scope but still worth a future cleanup.

(INFO/no-op) When user opt-out for a category is enabled, publish() returns ok:false silently — current behavior is correct per spec but is invisible to client callers; consider surfacing 'skipped_reason' in the _debug/publish response for QA clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: notification_publisher.publish() correctly enforces (a) catalog membership, (b) per-user opt-out, (c) deep-link templating with fallback_link, and is best-effort (never raises) — solid pattern.
Strict RBAC on /{id}/read and /{id}/archive is enforced via _load_for_user (both recipient_user_id AND tenant_id match), and verified 403 for cross-user PATCH/POST.
_debug/publish gated by is_super_admin — appropriate for QA helper.
Cron uses APScheduler BackgroundScheduler at 08:00 Europe/Rome, with a 20h dedup window via payload.action_id containment query — idempotent re-runs verified.
NotificationBell visibility-aware polling (60s visible / 600s hidden) is correctly armed via document.visibilitychange. Initial mount poll fires once for unread-count + categories — verified.

Drawer renders via createPortal, anchored top-right, with tabs all/unread/archived and per-item archive button — all data-testids present and consistent with spec (notification-bell, notification-bell-badge, notification-bell-highdot, notification-drawer, notification-tab-{all|unread|archived}, nb-item-{id}, nb-archive-{id}, nb-mark-all-read, nb-archive-read, nb-empty).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on M4 critical flows (bell, polling, drawer, tabs, archive, deep-link nav)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_M4 accounts/contacts/interactions/actions and TEST_M4 notifications during the run. Account fixture has a best-effort teardown via DELETE /api/relationships/accounts/{aid}. Residual TEST_M4 notifications may remain in relationship_notifications for admin user — they are mostly archived or read by end of suite and don't affect future runs since assertions use deltas (before→after).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter_m4_notification_center.py (20 tests, ~27s). Login via POST /api/auth/login returns {session:{access_token}}. The dev frontend is at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://content-hub-pro-22.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT blueprint.moodfordesign.com — that production frontend serves an OLDER bell component without M4 features). When testing UI, always use the preview emergentagent.com host so frontend code from /app is exercised. Cookie-based auth makes in-page fetch() to /_debug/publish return 401 unless the call goes through axios with its interceptor; use the API directly via pytest with Bearer instead for seeding.
